mapper.select: select a.id, a.gcs, a.category, a.code, a.name, a.short_name, a.polygon, a.parent_id, a.full_path, a.full_name, a.level, a.sort, a.style, a.remark, a.status, a.gmt_created, a.creator, a.gmt_modified from tb_region_range a where a.status = 0 and ( a.id = #{parentId} or a.parent_id = #{parentId} )
select count(1) as cou from tb_region_range a where a.status = 0 and code = #{code}

select b.id, b.gcs, b.category, b.code, b.name, b.short_name, b.polygon, b.parent_id, b.full_path, b.full_name, b.level, b.sort, b.style, b.remark, b.status, b.gmt_created, b.creator, b.gmt_modified from tb_region_org_relation a inner join tb_region_range b on a.region_id = b.id and a.status = 0 and b.status = 0 where a.org_id = #{orgId}
